name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Open to students worldwide for a joint master's delivered by a consortium of at least three universities in at least three countries, normally including a Spanish institution. The scholarship covers participation costs in full and contributes to travel, visa and living costs. Applications go to the consortium running the programme, not to the EU, and most windows run October to January.
stipend: EUR 1,400 per month for up to 24 months per the EU's published EMJM rate, plus travel and installation contributions

name: la Caixa Doctoral INPhINIT Fellowships
eligibility_summary: Open to researchers of any nationality for a doctorate at a university or research centre in Spain or Portugal. The Incoming call is for STEM disciplines at accredited centres of excellence and requires that the applicant has NOT lived or worked mainly in Spain or Portugal for more than twelve months in the three years before the deadline, which suits an applicant coming directly from Bangladesh. Candidates must not already have started doctoral studies.
stipend: EUR 35,800/yr to the host institution for employment costs (minimum gross salary EUR 25,000), plus EUR 3,500/yr research costs and doctoral tuition

name: MAEC-AECID Scholarships - Programa MASTER
provider: Spanish Agency for International Development Cooperation (AECID)
eligibility_summary: A development-cooperation award, not an open international competition. Restricted to public-sector employees who are nationals of listed Latin American countries and the Philippines. Applicants from other countries, including Bangladesh, are not eligible under the published call.
stipend: Academic costs of the master's plus a monthly living allowance; health and travel support in some modalities

name: Fundacion Carolina Postgraduate Scholarships
eligibility_summary: Restricted to nationals and residents of Ibero-American countries and Portugal, who must not already reside in Spain. Applicants from Bangladesh are not eligible. The 2026-2027 call offered 736 awards across postgraduate, doctoral and institutional programmes.
stipend: Tuition cover in full or in part, a monthly living allowance, return airfare and medical insurance, varying by programme

name: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship
provider: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT)
eligibility_summary: Covers tuition, admission and examination fees in full and pays a monthly living allowance, with international travel included. Applications are made through a Japanese embassy or directly by a recommending university.

name: Finland Scholarship
provider: Finnish Ministry of Education and Culture
eligibility_summary: A national award for first-year non-EU/EEA master's students that commonly combines full first-year tuition cover with a EUR 5,000 grant towards living costs.

name: Aalto University Excellence Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Awards a 50% or 100% tuition waiver to strong non-EU/EEA applicants. Decided automatically at admission; there is no separate application.

name: University of Helsinki Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Covers tuition in full and, at the highest award level, adds a EUR 10,000 annual grant towards living costs. Decided at admission.

name: MOE Tuition Grant (Singapore)
eligibility_summary: A government subsidy that substantially reduces published tuition for international students in return for a binding three-year commitment to work for a Singapore-registered employer after graduation.

name: Study in Saudi Arabia Government Scholarship
eligibility_summary: One free application covering more than 27 public universities. Awards typically include full tuition, accommodation, a monthly stipend, annual flights, health insurance and an arrival allowance. The ministry warns that no agent is authorised to charge for this.

name: KAUST Fellowship
provider: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
eligibility_summary: Awarded automatically to every admitted student. Covers full tuition, on-campus housing, medical and dental cover, relocation support and a living allowance. No separate scholarship application exists.

name: Turkiye Burslari Scholarship
provider: Republic of Turkiye, Presidency for Turks Abroad (YTB)
eligibility_summary: The Turkish government's flagship award: full tuition, a monthly stipend, accommodation, health insurance, one year of Turkish language tuition and return flights.

name: Ernst Mach Grant (OeAD)
provider: OeAD - Austria's Agency for Education and Internationalisation
eligibility_summary: A monthly grant for international students and researchers at Austrian institutions. OeAD notes that full-degree scholarships in Austria are rare; most funding is searchable on grants.at.
